Accessibility

Last updated: 9 October 2026

We want our website and services to be usable by as many people as possible.

Using the website

The site includes keyboard-accessible navigation, visible focus indicators, a skip-to-content link, responsive layouts and text alternatives for informative images. Scroll animations respect the reduced-motion setting on your device. Package information is provided as a table, with a package selector on smaller screens.

You can zoom using your browser controls. If you prefer less movement, enable reduced motion in your device's accessibility settings. The external Google booking service has its own accessibility features; you can contact us by email instead if it is difficult to use.

Tell us about a problem

Email contact@amkaccountancy.co.uk with the page, what you were trying to do and any difficulty you experienced. If useful, include your device, browser or assistive technology. Let us know if you need information in another format or an alternative way to contact us.

This is a statement of the features and support available, not a claim of independently certified accessibility compliance. We will consider reported barriers and work to address them.
